desc: 把上传的图片转为 ASCII 字符画：读取像素灰度，按亮度映射到 @#%*+=-:. 字符，输出可复制的文本，纯前端运行。

guide.zh:
## 功能

上传一张图片，按像素灰度亮度映射到 ASCII 字符（如 `@#%*+=-:.` ），生成可复制的字符画。可调节输出宽度、切换明暗方向、选择字符集。

## 使用场景

- 把头像 / logo 转成字符画用于 README 或论坛签名
- 制作复古风格的字符海报
- 理解亮度→字符映射的小演示

## 常见问题

- **支持格式**：PNG / JPG / GIF / WebP 等浏览器支持的图片格式
- **宽度**：字符画按字符宽度（列数）缩放，行数按图片比例自动折半（字符高宽比约 2:1）
- **明暗方向**：默认亮处用空格、暗处用 @；可反转用于深色背景
- **数据安全**：图片在浏览器本地读取处理，不上传服务器
guide.en:
## Features

Upload an image and convert it to ASCII art: each pixel's grayscale brightness maps to a character like `@#%*+=-:.` , producing copyable text. Adjust output width, flip light/dark direction, or switch character sets.

## Use cases

- Turn an avatar or logo into ASCII for a README or forum signature
- Make a retro text poster
- A small demo of brightness-to-character mapping

## FAQ

- **Formats**: PNG / JPG / GIF / WebP — anything the browser can decode
- **Width**: output is scaled to a character column count; rows are halved by image aspect (char aspect ≈ 2:1)
- **Light/dark**: by default bright pixels become spaces and dark ones @; flip it for dark backgrounds
- **Privacy**: the image is read and processed locally, nothing is uploaded

desc: 在线音频格式转换工具，支持 MP3、WAV、FLAC、OGG、M4A 互转，服务端 ffmpeg 处理。

guide.zh:
## 功能

上传音频文件，选择目标格式（MP3 / WAV / FLAC / OGG / M4A），由服务端 ffmpeg 转码后返回下载链接。

## 使用场景

- 把录音转成 MP3 方便分享和播放
- 将无损 FLAC 转为体积更小的 OGG 或 M4A
- 把各种格式统一转成 WAV 用于二次剪辑

## 常见问题

- **处理耗时**：大文件转码需要时间，提交后页面会自动轮询任务状态，完成后自动开始下载
- **支持格式**：输入支持常见音频格式，输出可选 MP3、WAV、FLAC、OGG、M4A（AAC）
- **文件大小**：受服务端处理能力限制，超大文件可能转换失败
guide.en:
## Features

Upload an audio file, pick a target format (MP3 / WAV / FLAC / OGG / M4A), and the server-side ffmpeg transcodes it and returns a download link.

## Use cases

- Convert recordings to MP3 for easy sharing and playback
- Shrink lossless FLAC into smaller OGG or M4A
- Normalize various formats into WAV for further editing

## FAQ

- **Processing time**: large files take longer; the page polls the job status and auto-downloads once done
- **Supported formats**: common audio inputs accepted; outputs include MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, M4A (AAC)
- **File size**: very large files may fail due to server-side limits

desc: 在线 Base64 编码解码工具，兼容 UTF-8 中文，纯浏览器本地处理不上传。

guide.zh:
## 功能

将文本编码为 Base64 字符串，或将 Base64 字符串解码回原文，完整兼容 UTF-8（含中文）。

## 使用场景

- 在 HTTP、URL 或 JSON 中传递二进制或特殊字符
- 解码 Data URI 中的图片、字体等内嵌资源
- 排查接口返回的 Base64 字段内容

## 常见问题

- **中文乱码**：本工具使用 UTF-8 安全的编解码方式，中文不会被替换成问号
- **解码失败**：输入包含非法字符或长度不正确时会提示错误，请检查是否完整复制
- **数据安全**：编解码完全在浏览器本地完成，不上传服务器
guide.en:
## Features

Encode text to a Base64 string or decode it back, with full UTF-8 support including CJK characters.

## Use cases

- Transport binary or special characters over HTTP, URL, or JSON
- Decode embedded images and fonts in Data URIs
- Inspect Base64 fields returned by APIs

## FAQ

- **Chinese garbled**: this tool uses a UTF-8-safe routine, so CJK text never turns into question marks
- **Decode error**: illegal characters or wrong length trigger an error; check that the input is fully copied
- **Privacy**: encoding and decoding run locally in your browser, nothing is uploaded

desc: 大五人格（OCEAN）测试，免费版 20 题、完整版 60 题李克特量表定位你在开放性、尽责性、外向性、宜人性、神经质五个维度上的百分比；免费看简版画像，完整版详细报告 ¥5 经站主确认后邮件送达。

guide.zh:
## 功能

通过 20 道李克特量表题（1-5 分，每维度 4 题）测量大五人格五维度（OCEAN）的百分比画像。免费查看五维度分数与简版解读；完整版含全部 60 题（每维度 12 题，题量更足、结果更稳），其报告（每维度深度解析 + 建议）为付费项，¥5 一次，经站主确认收款后邮件送达。

## 使用场景

- 想要基于科学模型的人格画像
- 自我成长、了解自己的情绪与社交倾向
- 团队建设中了解成员特质分布

## 常见问题

- **计分方式**：每题 1（很不符合）到 5（很符合），含反向计分题；每维度换算为 0-100 百分比
- **免费 vs 完整版**：免费给五维度百分比 + 简版高低解读；完整版给每维度深度解析与建议
- **完整版送达**：提交邮箱+交易号后，站主确认收款即把完整报告邮件发给你
- **数据安全**：作答仅在浏览器本地计分，不上传服务器（完整版报告文本随申请提交以邮件送达）
guide.en:
## Features

Answer 20 Likert-scale items (1-5, 4 per dimension) to get your Big Five (OCEAN) percentage profile. View the free brief profile with per-dimension scores; the full edition has all 60 items (12 per dimension—more items, more stable results), and its detailed report (deep-dive + tips per dimension) is a paid item, ¥5 one-time, emailed after the site owner confirms payment.

## Use cases

- A science-based personality profile
- Self-growth — understanding emotional and social tendencies
- Team building — seeing members' trait spread

## FAQ

- **Scoring**: each item 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree), some reverse-scored; each dimension becomes a 0-100 percentage
- **Free vs full**: free gives the five percentages + brief high/low read; the full report gives deep analysis and tips per dimension
- **Full delivery**: submit email + TXID; once the site owner confirms payment, the full report is emailed to you
- **Privacy**: scoring runs locally in your browser (the full-report text is submitted with the claim so it can be emailed)

desc: 纪念卡验真工具，输入卡面四要素与防伪码复算比对，纯前端验真并重新渲染原卡。

guide.zh:
## 功能

输入卡面四要素（姓名、主题、分数、完成时间）和防伪码，前端用与生成时相同的算法复算并比对，通过后重新渲染原纪念卡供下载。

## 使用场景

- 校验一张纪念卡是否被篡改或伪造
- 找回并重新下载之前生成的纪念卡
- 确认卡面信息与防伪码一致后再分享

## 常见问题

- **防伪码原理**：防伪码是卡面内容的内容指纹而非秘密，纯前端复算即可验真，无需服务端存储
- **验真失败**：请逐项核对姓名、主题、分数和完成时间是否与卡面完全一致，时间格式为「YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM」
- **数据安全**：所有计算在浏览器本地完成，卡面信息不上传服务器
guide.en:
## Features

Enter the four card fields (name, theme, score, completion time) plus the anti-counterfeit code; the page recomputes it with the same algorithm used at generation and compares, then re-renders the original card for download on match.

## Use cases

- Verify a memorial card has not been tampered with or forged
- Recover and re-download a previously generated card
- Confirm the card fields and anti-counterfeit code match before sharing

## FAQ

- **How the code works**: it is a content fingerprint, not a secret — recomputation runs purely client-side, no server storage needed
- **Verification failed**: double-check that name, theme, score and completion time exactly match the card; time format is YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM
- **Privacy**: all computation runs locally in your browser, card data is never uploaded

desc: 在线颜色转换工具，输入 HEX 实时输出 RGB 与 HSL，附色块预览，纯前端处理。

guide.zh:
## 功能

输入 HEX 颜色值，实时换算并展示对应的 RGB 与 HSL 表示，同时显示色块预览。

## 使用场景

- 在 CSS、设计稿之间统一颜色格式
- 快速查看某个 HEX 色值的 RGB 分量用于调色
- 把屏幕取色结果换算成 HSL 方便调整色相和饱和度

## 常见问题

- **输入格式**：支持带或不带「#」前缀的 6 位 HEX，例如「2563eb」或「#2563eb」
- **格式无效**：输入非 6 位十六进制字符时会提示错误
- **数据安全**：换算在浏览器本地完成，不上传服务器
guide.en:
## Features

Enter a HEX color and instantly get the equivalent RGB and HSL values, with a live swatch preview.

## Use cases

- Unify color formats between CSS and design mockups
- Inspect the RGB components of a HEX value for fine-tuning
- Convert a picked screen color into HSL to adjust hue and saturation

## FAQ

- **Input format**: accepts 6-digit HEX with or without a # prefix, e.g. 2563eb or #2563eb
- **Invalid format**: non-6-digit hex input triggers an error
- **Privacy**: conversion runs locally in your browser, nothing is uploaded

desc: DISC 行为风格测试，经典迫选 28 组（每组 D/I/S/C 四个描述，各选一个最像与最不像）定位你在支配 D、影响 I、稳健 S、严谨 C 四个维度上的风格，找出主导风格；免费看简版解读，完整版详细报告 ¥5 经站主确认后邮件送达。

guide.zh:
## 功能

经典迫选格式共 28 组，每组含 D / I / S / C 四个行为描述，你在每组各选一个『最像我』和『最不像我』，测量 DISC 四维度（D 支配 / I 影响 / S 稳健 / C 严谨）的风格强度，找出主导风格。免费查看主导风格与四维度简版解读（免费版取前 14 组）；完整版含全部 28 组，其报告（四维度深度解析 + 主导风格应用建议）为付费项，¥5 一次，经站主确认收款后邮件送达。

## 使用场景

- 了解自己在团队中的行为倾向
- 改善沟通、减少协作摩擦
- 招聘与岗位匹配参考

## 常见问题

- **计分方式**：每组四选最像 + 最不像；『最像』计入对应维度正向计数，『最不像』计入负向；每维度 pct = 该维度最像计数 / 组数 × 100，最高者为主导风格
- **免费 vs 完整版**：免费版取前 14 组，给主导风格 + 四维度百分比简版解读；完整版用全部 28 组，给每维度深度解析与应用建议
- **完整版送达**：提交邮箱+交易号后，站主确认收款即把完整报告邮件发给你
- **数据安全**：作答仅在浏览器本地计分，不上传服务器（完整版报告文本随申请提交以邮件送达）
guide.en:
## Features

Classic forced-choice format: 28 groups, each with four D / I / S / C behavioral descriptors; in each group you pick one "most like me" and one "least like me", measuring your DISC profile (D Dominance / I Influence / S Steadiness / C Conscientiousness) and finding your primary style. View the free brief read of your primary style and four-dimension scores (free edition uses the first 14 groups); the full edition has all 28 groups, and its detailed report (deep-dive per dimension + application tips) is a paid item, ¥5 one-time, emailed after the site owner confirms payment.

## Use cases

- Understanding your behavioral tendencies in teams
- Improving communication, reducing friction
- Reference for hiring and role-fit

## FAQ

- **Scoring**: each group, pick one "most like me" + one "least like me"; "most" adds to that dimension's positive count, "least" to its negative; each dimension's pct = its most-count / groups × 100; the highest is your primary style
- **Free vs full**: free uses the first 14 groups, giving the primary style + brief per-dimension read; the full edition uses all 28 groups, giving deep analysis and application tips per dimension
- **Full delivery**: submit email + TXID; once the site owner confirms payment, the full report is emailed to you
- **Privacy**: scoring runs locally in your browser (the full-report text is submitted with the claim so it can be emailed)

desc: 在线文档格式转换工具，支持 Word、PDF、TXT、ODT、RTF、HTML 互转，服务端 LibreOffice 处理。

guide.zh:
## 功能

上传文档文件，选择目标格式（PDF / DOCX / TXT / ODT / RTF / HTML），由服务端 LibreOffice 转换后返回下载链接。

## 使用场景

- 把 Word 文档转成 PDF 方便分发和打印
- 将 PDF 或 ODT 文档转成 DOCX 以便编辑
- 把各种格式统一转成 TXT 或 HTML 用于内容提取

## 常见问题

- **处理耗时**：大文件或复杂排版转换需要时间，页面会自动轮询任务状态，完成后自动开始下载
- **支持格式**：输入支持 DOCX、DOC、PDF、ODT、RTF、TXT，输出可选 PDF、DOCX、TXT、ODT、RTF、HTML
- **排版差异**：跨格式转换可能存在字体或排版差异，建议转换后检查关键页面
guide.en:
## Features

Upload a document and pick a target format (PDF / DOCX / TXT / ODT / RTF / HTML); the server-side LibreOffice converts it and returns a download link.

## Use cases

- Turn Word documents into PDF for distribution and printing
- Convert PDF or ODT into DOCX for editing
- Normalize various formats into TXT or HTML for content extraction

## FAQ

- **Processing time**: large or complex files take longer; the page polls the job status and auto-downloads once done
- **Supported formats**: inputs include DOCX, DOC, PDF, ODT, RTF, TXT; outputs include PDF, DOCX, TXT, ODT, RTF, HTML
- **Layout drift**: cross-format conversion may differ in fonts or layout; review key pages afterwards

desc: 在线时间长度换算工具，输入数值与单位输出复合分解及各单位等价，纯前端计算。

guide.zh:
## 功能

输入一个数值并选择单位（年 / 月 / 周 / 天 / 时 / 分 / 秒 / 毫秒），输出复合分解形式（如 31 年 251 天 7 小时 46 分 40 秒）以及换算到各单位的等价值。

## 使用场景

- 计算一段总时长（毫秒或秒）对应多少天多少小时
- 把年、月单位换算成更细的小时或秒用于排期
- 验证时间戳或定时器间隔的单位换算结果

## 常见问题

- **年月近似**：年为 365.25 天，月为 30.4375 天，复合分解时跳过月和周以保证确定性
- **超大数值**：当数值过大或过小时自动用科学计数法展示，避免显示一长串零
- **数据安全**：换算在浏览器本地完成，不上传服务器
guide.en:
## Features

Enter a value and a unit (year / month / week / day / hour / minute / second / millisecond) to get a compound breakdown (e.g. 31 years 251 days 7 hours 46 minutes 40 seconds) plus the equivalent in every unit.

## Use cases

- Convert a total duration (ms or seconds) into days and hours
- Break year or month values into finer hours or seconds for scheduling
- Verify unit conversions for timestamps or timer intervals

## FAQ

- **Year and month are approximate**: a year is 365.25 days and a month is 30.4375 days; compound breakdown skips month and week for determinism
- **Very large values**: extremely large or small numbers are shown in scientific notation to avoid long strings of zeros
- **Privacy**: conversion runs locally in your browser, nothing is uploaded

desc: 经典 2048 小游戏，方向键或滑动合并相同数字，冲分通关可获纪念卡，纯前端运行。

guide.zh:
## 功能

4x4 网格上通过方向键或屏幕滑动移动所有方块，相同数字合并并相加，每次移动随机生成一个新方块，目标是拼出 2048。

## 使用场景

- 休闲碎片时间玩两把数字合并益智
- 挑战最高分，刷新本地记录
- 通关后领取专属纪念卡收藏或分享

## 常见问题

- **操作方式**：键盘方向键移动，移动端可滑动屏幕或使用屏上方向键
- **最高分保存**：最高分存储在浏览器本地，清除站点数据会重置
- **无法移动**：当所有方向都无法合并且无空格时游戏结束
guide.en:
## Features

On a 4x4 grid, move all tiles with arrow keys or swipes; equal numbers merge and add up, a new tile spawns each move, and the goal is to reach 2048.

## Use cases

- Kill time with a number-merging puzzle
- Chase a higher score and beat your local best
- Earn an exclusive memorial card on completion to collect or share

## FAQ

- **Controls**: arrow keys on desktop, swipe or on-screen D-pad on touch devices
- **Best score**: stored locally in the browser; clearing site data resets it
- **No moves left**: the game ends when no direction can merge and no empty cell remains

desc: 德式经典《农场主》规则复刻：14 轮 6 阶段工人放置、5×3 农场经营（建房/犁田/播种/围栏牧场）、收获喂食压力、40 职业 + 40 小改进 + 10 大设施。1-5 人热座同屏对局（手牌隐私交接），支持 AI 机器人补位，纯前端运行。

guide.zh:
## 功能

《农场主》规则复刻（1-5 人）：14 轮轮流放工——拿资源（累积格越晚拿越多）、建房与马厩、犁田播种烤面包、围栏圈牧场养羊/猪/牛、翻新房屋、家庭成长、打出职业与小改进、购买大设施。收获轮（4/7/9/11/13/14）田间收获 → 喂食（每家庭成员 2 食，缺口每 1 食 = 1 乞讨卡 −3 分）→ 牲畜繁殖（≥2 只且有栏位 +1）。终局按田/牧场/谷/菜/畜/家庭/房/马厩/空地/乞讨/卡牌计分。

## 使用场景

- 和朋友同屏热座来一局完整德策（支持混合 AI 机器人补位，单人也能开局）
- 学习《农场主》规则：工人放置、食物经济、牧场容量等细节引擎完整实现
- 随机种子可复现同一局，方便复盘讨论

## 常见问题

- **怎么开局**：配置 1-5 个座位（可切换人类/AI），每人发 7 职业 + 7 小改进；每轮依次放工
- **放工**：点击行动板高亮的格子；累积格（黏土/芦苇/石头/食物/动物）没人拿会每轮 +1；专长格（建/犁/播/围栏/翻新/打牌）进入子阶段，按面板提示点农场格或按钮完成
- **围栏**：子阶段里点空地圈选（再点撤销），围栏总花费实时显示；牧场容量 = 2×(格数 + 马厩数)，马厩在牧场里翻倍容量
- **喂食**：收获时每家庭成员 2 食（新生儿 1 食）；谷物/蔬菜 1:1 直食，牲畜须有烹饪设备转化；缺口每 1 食 = 1 乞讨卡（终局 −3 分/张）
- **家庭成长**：需有空房；第 14 轮的成长格无需空房
- **悔棋**：付费悔棋回退到最近一次人类决策状态
- **隐私**：多人人类对局换手时有交接遮罩，手牌只显示当前玩家
- **数据声明**：⚠ 行动板为 2-5 人共用（官方分人数不同规格，本实现 4+ 人追加第二雇工格、5 人追加第二伐木格）；40 职业 + 40 小改进为记忆重建 + 自创平衡混合（官方 E-deck 139+139），全部数值「待核对」；已知规则偏差：子阶段可零操作取消、翻新可不翻只购大设施、动物溢出自动烹煮/丢弃、卡上栏位为单一共享池、播种留 1 棵计分的口径（谷 1→田 2）
guide.en:
## Features

An Agricola rules implementation (1-5 players): 14 rounds of worker placement — accumulating resource spaces, building rooms and stables, plowing and sowing (and baking bread), fencing pastures for sheep/boar/cattle, renovating rooms, family growth, playing occupations and minor improvements, buying major improvements. Harvest rounds (4/7/9/11/13/14): field harvest → feeding (2 food per family member, each missing food = 1 begging card, −3VP) → breeding (2+ animals with capacity → +1). Final scoring covers fields / pastures / grain / vegetables / animals / family / rooms / stables / unused spaces / begging / cards.

## Use cases

- Play a full heavy Euro with friends on one screen (hot seat with AI bots filling seats — solo works too)
- Learn Agricola's rules: worker placement, the food economy, pasture capacity and more are all in the engine
- The random seed reproduces the same game for review and discussion

## FAQ

- **Setup**: configure 1-5 seats (human or AI); each player gets 7 occupations + 7 minor improvements; place workers in turn each round
- **Placing**: click a highlighted space on the action board; accumulating spaces (clay/reed/stone/food/animals) grow +1 per round when untaken; special spaces (build/plow/sow/fence/renovate/play cards) enter a sub-phase — follow the panel and click farm cells or buttons
- **Fences**: in the sub-phase click empty cells to select (click again to undo), with live total cost; pasture capacity = 2×(cells + stables), stables inside a pasture double its capacity
- **Feeding**: at harvest each family member eats 2 food (newborns 1); grain/vegetables convert 1:1, animals need a cooking device; each missing food = 1 begging card (−3VP each at the end)
- **Family growth**: needs a free room; the round-14 growth space needs no room
- **Undo**: paid undo rolls back to your latest decision point
- **Privacy**: with multiple humans a handoff mask appears between turns; hands are only shown for the current player
- **Data disclaimer**: ⚠ one shared action board for 2-5 players (official boards scale by count; this build adds a second day-laborer space at 4+ and a second wood space at 5); the 40 occupations + 40 minor improvements are a memory-reconstruction with original balancing (official E-deck is 139+139), all values "to verify"; known deviations: sub-phases can be cancelled with zero actions, renovation can be skipped in favor of buying a major, animal overflow auto-cooks/discards, the card stable is a single shared pool, sowing keeps 1 grain for scoring (1 grain → 2 on the field)

desc: 重策桌游《方舟动物园》基础版完整复刻：128 张动物卡 + 64 张协会卡构成 192 张主牌堆（另含 5 张 X 卡）、5 张行动卡档位机制（用卡降档、闲置升档、超 5 打烊）、市场位置费与暗置补位、围栏建造（体型/岩石/水域/同种限制）、22 个保护项目、协会行动（大学/合作动物园/声望轨）、终局卡二选一与「魅力 ×2 − 保护点」计分。1-4 人热座同屏对局，支持 AI 机器人补位与联机房间，纯前端运行。

guide.zh:
## 快速上手（3 分钟看懂）

你是动物园园长，目标只有一个：**终局得分 = 魅力 × 2 − 保护点**。魅力靠动物和设施堆，保护点靠项目和高保护动物拿——两条腿都要走，只堆魅力会输。

**第一轮照着做就懂了：**

1. 开局先从两张终局卡里**选 1 张**（它是你的加分目标，看不懂就选顺眼的）
2. 点一张**行动卡**执行行动（卡上点数 = 档位，越高越强）：
   - 🦁 动物卡：把手牌里的动物放进围栏（预算 = 8 × 档位，放越贵动物越要高档位）
   - 🤝 协会卡：拿资金 / 建大学 / 建合作动物园 / 升声望 / 完成项目
   - 🏗 建造卡：建围栏、宠物角、爬行馆、大鸟舍、小卖部、餐厅
   - 🃏 卡牌卡：抽牌 + 从市场拿牌（市场最左边那张**免费**，越往右越贵）
   - 💼 赞助卡：拿资金 + 打出协会赞助卡（各种持续加成）
3. 用过的卡降到 1 档，其他卡 +1 档——所以"攒档位"和"用卡"要规划

## 核心机制（白话版）

- **行动卡档位**：5 张卡各管一类行动，强度 1-5。用一张它回 1 档、其余全体 +1；被抬过 5 的卡"打烊"进休息区（ ☕ ），可以付持有者 2 币借用来应急（按 1 档执行）
- **市场**：左起 5 张明牌，位置 0 免费、1-4 位要付对应金币；右端 3 张暗牌补位，拿走一张左边整体左移
- **X 卡与打烊**：牌堆里混着 5 张 X，抽到第 5 张全场"打烊"——每人领收入（基础 3 + 小卖部×2 + 餐厅×4）、休息区卡归位、手牌超 8 要弃牌。这是节奏事件不是惩罚，别怕
- **放动物的条件**：体型占围栏格数、岩石 ⛳ 与水域 🌊 需求要满足、每种动物全园限 1 只、卡面图标需求（大学 🏫 / 合作动物园 🤝 等）要够；家畜只能进宠物角，爬行动物进爬行馆、大鸟进鸟舍
- **声望轨**：1-5 格，升格付入场费（2-5 币）。**声望到 5 且保护点达门槛（2 人局 10 / 3 人局 12 / 4 人局 14）就触发终局**；牌堆二次耗尽或回合数达上限也会收束
- **终局卡**：开局二选一，终局按你的动物园形态给额外保护点（只帮你够门槛，不直接进分）

## 使用场景

- 1-4 人同屏热座来一局重策动物园经营（AI 机器人可补位，也可全部 AI 观战）
- 想入门《方舟动物园》实体桌游前的规则学习器：放置合法性、图标需求、终局触发全部按规则引擎判定，点错会告诉你差什么
- 联机房间与好友各设备对局；随机种子可复现同一局复盘

## 常见问题（新手卡点）

- **为什么我的动物放不进围栏**：点一下放不进的手牌动物，界面会用白话告诉你原因——空间不足 / 缺岩石 / 缺水域 / 同种已养 / 图标需求不够 / 预算不够（动物预算 = 8 × 动物卡档位，不是现金！）
- **行卡为什么不亮**：打烊（☕）的卡不能用，除非去"休息区借用"付 2 币；没亮也没 ☕ 说明当前阶段不对
- **钱有什么用**：建造、市场位置费、升声望、借用他人休息卡。**放动物不花现金**，花的是动物行动预算
- **保护点怎么拿**：完成保护项目（协会行动里点高亮项目）、放置高保护点动物、部分协会卡。注意计分是**减**保护点，但保护点是你触发终局的门票，两者要平衡
- **终局什么时候来**：任一玩家声望 5 + 保护点达标，或牌堆二次耗尽，或回合上限（防拖延兜底）。触发后打完本轮就计分

## 数据与规则声明

128 张基础版动物卡与 64 张协会卡的数值（体型/价格/岩石/水域/需求/标签/魅力/保护点/声望）誊录自开源实现（MIT，BASE 源筛除海洋世界扩展与 promo，161 张中基础版恰为 128 + 64 = 192）；动物中文名为标准中文名自行翻译。协会卡效果数值开源数据未含，按官方卡牌语义赋值；性别字段开源数据缺失，按 id 数位合成约各半（繁育项目按官方"同类异性成对"执行）。国家公园（放归机制）与个别依赖实体配件的项目未实现，共保留 22 个可引擎化项目；回合上限（60/人）为本实现防拖延兜底，非官方规则。

动物图片来自 [Wikimedia Commons](/tools/game-arknova/img/ATTRIBUTIONS.md)（各物种维基百科条目导语图，CC BY / CC BY-SA / 公有领域授权，逐卡来源见 ATTRIBUTIONS）。
guide.en:
## Quick start (3 minutes)

You run a zoo. One goal: **final score = appeal × 2 − conservation points**. Appeal comes from animals and facilities; conservation points come from projects and high-CP animals — you need both, appeal alone loses.

**Your first round:**

1. Pick 1 of 2 endgame cards (your bonus goal — pick whichever looks reachable)
2. Tap an action card to act (its pips = strength, higher is stronger):
   - 🦁 Animals: place animals from hand into enclosures (budget = 8 × strength)
   - 🤝 Association: funds / university / partner zoo / reputation / projects
   - 🏗 Build: enclosures, petting zoo, reptile house, aviary, kiosk, restaurant
   - 🃏 Cards: draw + take from the market (leftmost market card is free)
   - 💼 Sponsors: funds + play sponsor cards for ongoing bonuses
3. The used card drops to strength 1 and all others rise — plan your strengths

## Core mechanics, plainly

- **Action card strengths**: 5 cards cover 5 action types, strength 1-5. Playing one resets it to 1 and raises the rest; a card pushed past 5 "breaks" to the rest area (☕), borrowable for 2 coins at strength 1
- **Market**: 5 face-up cards; slot 0 free, slots 1-4 cost their position number; 3 hidden cards refill from the right; taking one slides the row left
- **X cards & the break**: 5 X cards hide in the deck; the 5th one drawn triggers a break — everyone collects income (3 base + 2×kiosks + 4×restaurants), rest-area cards return, hands over 8 discard. It's a pacing event, not a punishment
- **Placing animals**: size fills enclosure slots, rock ⛳ / water 🌊 needs must fit, one of each species per zoo, icon requirements (universities 🏫 / partner zoos 🤝 …) must be met; pets go to the petting zoo, reptiles to the reptile house, large birds to the aviary
- **Reputation track**: 1-5, each step up costs an entry fee (2-5 coins). Reputation 5 + enough CP (2p: 10 / 3p: 12 / 4p: 14) triggers the endgame; double deck exhaustion or the turn cap also end the game
- **Endgame card**: pick 1 of 2 at setup; grants bonus CP matching your zoo shape (counts toward the gate only, not raw score)

## Use cases

- 1-4 player hot-seat heavy strategy on one screen (AI bots fill seats; all-AI spectator games work too)
- A rules trainer before playing the physical game: placement legality, icon requirements and endgame triggers are all engine-enforced, with plain-language feedback when a move is illegal
- Online rooms with friends per device; seeds reproduce games for review

## FAQ (newbie sticking points)

- **Why won't my animal go in**: tap the animal in your hand and the UI tells you why — no space / missing rocks / missing water / species already housed / icon requirements unmet / over budget (animal budget = 8 × the animals card's strength, not cash!)
- **Why is an action card dim**: broken (☕) cards can't be used except via "borrow from rest area" for 2 coins; a dim card without ☕ just means the phase is wrong
- **What's money for**: building, market slot costs, reputation fees, borrowing rest-area cards. Placing animals costs budget, not cash
- **How do I get conservation points**: complete conservation projects (highlighted in the association action), place high-CP animals, some sponsor cards. Scoring subtracts CP, but CP is your ticket to triggering the endgame — balance both
- **When does the game end**: any player at reputation 5 + CP goal, double deck exhaustion, or the turn cap (anti-stall backstop). The current round finishes, then scoring

## Data & rules disclaimer

The 128 base animals and 64 base sponsors (size/price/rocks/water/requirements/tags/appeal/CP/reputation) are transcribed from an open-source MIT implementation (BASE source only, excluding the Marine Worlds expansion and promos; of 161 total cards exactly 128 + 64 = 192 are base); Chinese animal names are standard translated names. Sponsor effect values are absent from the source data and assigned per the official card semantics; the gender field is synthesized from card ids (roughly half each) since the source lacks it (breeding projects follow the official mated-pair rule). National parks (release mechanic) and a few component-dependent projects are not implemented — 22 engine-compatible projects remain; the per-player turn cap (60) is an anti-stall backstop, not an official rule.

Animal photos are from [Wikimedia Commons](/tools/game-arknova/img/ATTRIBUTIONS.md) (lead images of each species' Wikipedia article, CC BY / CC BY-SA / public domain; per-card sources in ATTRIBUTIONS).

desc: 经典拼块桌游《卡卡颂》基础版完整复刻：72 块地形块（起始块 + 71 抽牌堆）、四类地形（城市/道路/草地/修道院）、边三段槽位农田连接模型、随从驻守与多数方计分、完成城市/道路/修道院即时结算、终局未完成减半 + 农夫 3 分/完成城市（C1 规则）。2-5 人热座同屏对局，支持 AI 机器人补位，纯前端运行。

guide.zh:
## 功能

《卡卡颂》基础版规则复刻（2-5 人）：起始块（城市一头 + 横穿道路）居中，每回合从 71 块牌堆抽 1 块，旋转后放进与既有块边地形匹配的空格（城市对城市、道路对道路、草地对草地）；抽出的块无处可放则弃掉重抽（官方规则）。放块后可派 1 个随从（共 7 个）驻守该块上的一个地形区：城市、道路、草地（农夫）或修道院——前提是该连通区上尚无随从。

完成即结算：城市被围死（所有城市边封闭）得 2 分/块 + 2 分/纹章，道路两端到头得 1 分/块，修道院被 3×3 围满得 9 分；同一区多个随从按人数多数方得分，并列多方均得全额，结算后随从归还。放在落块瞬间即已完成的特征上的随从立即结算归还（官方裁决）。牌堆放尽进入终局：未完成城市 1 分/块 + 1 分/纹章、未完成道路 1 分/块、修道院按 3×3 已占格数、农夫按每块农田相邻的完成城市数 × 3 分（多数方得）。

## 使用场景

- 和朋友同屏热座来一局经典拼块版图桌游（支持混合 AI 机器人补位）
- 学习《卡卡颂》规则：农田"边三段"连接、多数并列均得、终局减半等细节引擎完整实现
- 随机种子可复现同一局，方便复盘讨论

## 常见问题

- **怎么开局**：配置 2-5 个座位（可切换人类/AI），起始块已摆好，先手直接抽块放置
- **放块规则**：点击高亮格落块，↺↻ 旋转当前块；高亮只显示当前朝向可放的位置，旋转后高亮随之变化
- **派随从**：放块后点击块上的圆点驻守对应地形；圆点不出现说明该区已有随从或无随从可用，可点"不放随从"跳过
- **农田连接**：草地按"边三段"模型连通——整边草地对接整边草地，道路两侧的草地带跨块相连（模型与 carcassonne-api 一致）
- **农夫**：终局才结算，每个相邻完成城市 3 分；采用流传最广的 C1 经典规则（不做 C2 的三块城市 5 分细分）
- **多数并列**：同区并列最多的多方各得全额分数
- **无处可放**：抽到的块全盘无合法位置时自动弃掉换下一块（日志可见）
- **悔棋**：付费悔棋回退到最近一次人类待决策状态
- **数据声明**：24 种地形块构成与数量（起始 D×1，牌堆 A2、B4、C1、D3、E5、F2、G1、H3、I2、J3、K3、L3、M2、N3、O2、P3、Q1、R3、S2、T1、U8、V9、W4、X1 共 71 块）、纹章分布（C/F/M/O/Q/S 共 10 块）、边地形与农田连接关系，誊录自 carcassonne-api allPlayTileTypes.json（wikicarpedia C2 官方瓦片命名），并与 bacher、carcassonne 两个独立实现三源交叉验证；计分规则按基础版官方规则（农夫采用 C1 3 分制并在此注明）
guide.en:
## Features

A Carcassonne base-game rules implementation (2-5 players): the start tile (one city edge + a crossing road) sits in the middle; each turn draw from the 71-tile deck and place it rotated into any empty cell whose touching edges match (city to city, road to road, grass to grass); a drawn tile with no legal spot is discarded and redrawn (official rule). After placing you may deploy one of your 7 followers onto a feature of that tile — city, road, field (farmer) or monastery — provided no follower sits on that connected feature yet.

Completed features score immediately: a walled-in city earns 2 points per tile + 2 per pennant, a road with both ends terminated earns 1 per tile, a monastery surrounded by its 3×3 neighbourhood earns 9; when several followers share a feature the majority side scores, ties all score full points, and followers return after scoring. A follower placed on a feature that was already completed by the tile placement scores and returns immediately (official ruling). When the deck runs out the game ends: incomplete cities 1 per tile + 1 per pennant, incomplete roads 1 per tile, monasteries 1 per occupied cell in the 3×3, and farmers 3 points per completed city adjacent to their field (majority side).

## Use cases

- Play this classic tile-laying game with friends on one screen (hot seat, with AI bots filling seats)
- Learn Carcassonne's rules: the edge-thirds field connectivity, tied majorities, endgame half scoring and other details are fully implemented
- The random seed reproduces the same game for review and discussion

## FAQ

- **Setup**: configure 2-5 seats (human or AI); the start tile is pre-placed and the first player draws right away
- **Placing tiles**: click a highlighted cell to place, rotate with ↺↻; highlights show only spots legal for the current orientation and refresh as you rotate
- **Followers**: after placing, click a dot on the tile to deploy onto that feature; missing dots mean the feature already has a follower or you have none left, and you can click "Skip follower"
- **Field connectivity**: grass connects via the edge-thirds model — full grass edges join, and the grass strips flanking a road continue across tiles (same model as carcassonne-api)
- **Farmers**: score only at game end, 3 points per adjacent completed city; the widely accepted classic C1 rule is used (not the C2 5-points-for-3-tile-cities variant)
- **Tied majorities**: every side tied for most followers on a feature scores full points
- **Dead draws**: a tile with no legal spot anywhere is auto-discarded and another is drawn (visible in the log)
- **Undo**: paid undo rolls back to your latest decision point
- **Data disclaimer**: the 24 tile types and quantities (start D×1 plus deck A2, B4, C1, D3, E5, F2, G1, H3, I2, J3, K3, L3, M2, N3, O2, P3, Q1, R3, S2, T1, U8, V9, W4, X1 = 71 tiles), pennant distribution (10 tiles across C/F/M/O/Q/S), edge terrains and field connectivity are transcribed from carcassonne-api's allPlayTileTypes.json (wikicarpedia C2 naming) and cross-validated against the bacher and carcassonne implementations; scoring follows the official base rules (farmers use the classic C1 3-point rule, noted here)

desc: 经典资源拓殖桌游《卡坦岛》基础版完整复刻：官方 19 格岛屿变体摆盘 + 数字 token + 9 港口、蛇形初始放置、双骰产出、村庄/城市/道路建造、银行与港口交易、国内贸易、强盗与骑士、最长路/最大军队、发展卡、10 分获胜。3-4 人热座同屏明牌对局，支持 AI 机器人补位，纯前端运行。

guide.zh:
## 功能

《卡坦岛》基础版规则复刻（3-4 人）：变体摆盘（地形/数字/港口洗牌），蛇形初始放置——按 1→N→N→1 顺位连放两轮村庄 + 道路，第二轮村庄立即结算产出。之后每回合掷双骰：数字格产资源（村庄 1 张、城市 2 张，强盗压格不产，银行缺卡按余量截断）；掷 7 则超 7 张者弃一半 → 移动强盗 → 从强盗格旁任选一家抢 1 张（明牌自选资源种类）。

主阶段可任意次：建路（1 木 1 砖，15 条上限）、建村（1 木 1 砖 1 羊 1 麦，距离规则须距既有建筑 ≥2 且连己方路，5 座上限）、升城（2 麦 3 矿，4 座上限）、买发展卡（1 羊 1 麦 1 矿，25 张：14 骑士 / 2 修路 / 2 丰年 / 2 垄断 / 5 分卡）。发展卡当回合买不可当回合打；骑士打开即移强盗抢牌，3 骑士得最大军队 +2 分（可夺走）；5 段连续路得最长路 +2 分（可夺走，可被对手在中间建村截断）。交易：银行 4:1、通用港 3:1、专属港 2:1，或与任意对手按任意比率商量（提议 → 对方裁决）。自己回合达到 10 分即胜。

## 使用场景

- 和朋友同屏热座来一局经典资源管理与谈判桌游（支持混合 AI 机器人补位）
- 学习《卡坦岛》规则：距离规则、银行短缺、最长路截断等细节引擎完整实现
- 随机种子可复现同一局，方便复盘讨论

## 常见问题

- **怎么开局**：配置 3-4 个座位（可切换人类/AI），地形与数字 token 随机摆盘，先按 1→N 放村庄 + 道路，再逆序 N→1 放第二轮，第二轮村庄立即得初始资源
- **建村限制**：距离规则——与任何村庄/城市至少隔一个顶点；还须连着己方道路网络
- **掷 7**：手上超 7 张资源先弃一半（点自己面板的资源芯片），再移动强盗（点格子），有相邻他家建筑则抢 1 张
- **交易**：主界面下方"银行交易"按你的港口比率自动换算；"国内交易"选对象与双向资源数量提出提议，对方点接受/拒绝
- **发展卡**：买来当回合不能打（分卡除外，分卡直接计入 VP 无需打出）；每回合至多打 1 张
- **最强路被截断**：对手在你路中间的合法空点建村会切断你的最长路
- **悔棋**：付费悔棋回退到最近一次人类待决策状态
- **数据声明**：地形组成（森 4 / 丘 3 / 牧 4 / 田 4 / 山 3 / 沙 1）、数字 token 组（2-12 无 7）、发展卡构成（14/2/2/2/5）、建造费用与棋子上限均按官方基础版规则誊录；港口位置采用 9 个均匀分布的海岸位（与官方海框架的 9 港口位分布一致），专属/通用标记洗牌落位（官方变体开局）；数字 token 按官方螺旋序摆放（变体开局 token 面朝下洗牌，起点与旋向仅影响摆盘结构）
- **明牌设计**：本作按官方"全家公开资源"变体实现——所有玩家资源与发展卡在面板全公开，国内交易直接在主屏裁决，因此放弃了对局中的隐藏信息博弈
guide.en:
## Features

A Catan base-game rules implementation (3-4 players): variable board setup (shuffled terrain, number tokens and harbours), snake initial placement — two rounds of settlement + road in 1→N→N→1 order with immediate income on the second settlement. Each turn roll two dice: matching hexes produce (settlement 1, city 2; robber blocks; bank shortages pay what remains). Rolling a 7 forces everyone above 7 cards to discard half, then you move the robber and steal 1 card of a chosen type from an adjacent opponent (open hands).

In the main phase you may build any number of: roads (1 wood 1 brick, cap 15), settlements (1 wood 1 brick 1 sheep 1 wheat, distance rule + connected to your road network, cap 5), cities (2 wheat 3 ore, cap 4), and development cards (1 sheep 1 wheat 1 ore; 25 total: 14 knights / 2 road building / 2 year of plenty / 2 monopoly / 5 VP). A dev card bought this turn cannot be played this turn; knights move the robber and steal, 3 knights earn Largest Army +2 VP (stealable); a 5-segment road earns Longest Road +2 VP (stealable, breakable by an opponent's settlement). Trade: bank 4:1, generic harbour 3:1, specialty harbour 2:1, or negotiate any ratio with opponents (offer → accept/decline). Reach 10 VP on your turn to win.

## Use cases

- Play this classic resource-management and negotiation game with friends on one screen (hot seat, with AI bots filling seats)
- Learn Catan's rules: distance rule, bank shortage, longest-road breaking and other details are fully implemented
- The random seed reproduces the same game for review and discussion

## FAQ

- **Setup**: configure 3-4 seats (human or AI); terrain and tokens are shuffled; place settlement + road in 1→N order, then N→1 for the second round with immediate income
- **Settlement limits**: distance rule — at least one empty vertex from any building; must also touch your road network
- **Rolling a 7**: hands above 7 cards discard half (click the resource chips on your panel), then move the robber (click a hex) and steal from an adjacent opponent
- **Trading**: the bank-trade form applies your harbour ratio automatically; the domestic-trade form picks a partner and both sides' resources for an offer they accept or decline
- **Development cards**: cannot be played the turn they are bought (VP cards count directly and are never played); at most one per turn
- **Broken roads**: an opponent's settlement placed inside your path cuts your longest road
- **Undo**: paid undo rolls back to your latest decision point
- **Data disclaimer**: terrain composition (forest 4 / hills 3 / pasture 4 / fields 4 / mountains 3 / desert 1), the number-token set (2-12 without 7), dev-card composition (14/2/2/2/5), build costs and piece caps follow the official base game; harbours sit on 9 evenly spread coastal spots (matching the official sea frame's 9 harbour positions) with shuffled specialty/generic markers (official variable setup); number tokens follow the official spiral placement (tokens are shuffled face-down in the variable setup, so the start point and direction only shape the board)
- **Open hands**: this implementation uses the official "all resources public" variant — every player's resources and dev cards are visible on their panel and domestic trades resolve on the main screen, deliberately trading away hidden-information play

desc: 德式经典《电力公司》完整规则复刻：电厂拍卖、动态资源价格梯、德国地图城市扩张、三阶段节奏与结算。2-6 人热座同屏对局，支持 AI 机器人补位，纯前端运行。

guide.zh:
## 功能

《电力公司》完整规则复刻（2-6 人）：每轮五个阶段——按顺位拍卖电厂（现货 4 张+期货、起拍价=面值）、购买资源（市场越空越贵，铀第 9 档起跳 10/12/14/16）、建设城市（首城免连接费，Dijkstra 最短连接）、 bureaucracy 结算发电收入，随后补给资源、移除市场最高厂。Step 1/2/3 节奏切换（第 7 城触发 Step2、抽到 Step3 卡进入 Step3）、终局城市数按人数（21/17/15/17/14）全部实现。

## 使用场景

- 和朋友同屏热座来一局完整德策（支持混合 AI 机器人补位，单人也能开局）
- 学习《电力公司》规则：拍卖轮转、资源价格梯、市场重排等细节引擎完整实现
- 随机种子可复现同一局，方便复盘讨论

## 常见问题

- **怎么开局**：配置 2-6 个座位（可切换人类/AI），开局轮流选择相邻地图区域
- **拍卖规则**：起拍者按面值起拍（未被人加价前不可退出）；他人可加价或退出；全退则起拍者以底价成交
- **资源价格**：资源占最贵端区块、从最便宜格买 → 市场越空越贵；煤/油/垃圾满 24 件时 1 块钱，铀剩 1 件 16 块
- **存储容量**：每种燃料可存该类电厂需求量 ×2；混燃（煤/油）容量煤油共享
- **终局条件**：任一玩家城市数达标（按人数 21/17/15/17/14），本轮打完结算：供电城市数 → 电厂容量 → 余额
- **悔棋**：付费悔棋回退到最近一次人类待决策状态
- **地图与数据**：地图为官方德国版图誊录（42 城、6 区各 7 城、83 条连接边逐边费用，经三个独立开源实现交叉验证）；数值表来自对官方规则的记忆整理，存疑项已在代码中标注「待核对」
guide.en:
## Features

A full-rules implementation of Power Grid (2-6 players): five phases each round — plant auction in turn order (4 current + future market, opening bid = face value), resource buying (the emptier the market the higher the price; uranium jumps 10/12/14/16 from slot 9), city building (first city free of connection cost, Dijkstra shortest path), and bureaucracy income settlement, followed by resource refill and removing the highest plant. Step 1/2/3 progression (7th city triggers Step 2, drawing the Step 3 card enters Step 3) and player-count endgame city targets (21/17/15/17/14) are all implemented.

## Use cases

- Play a full heavy Euro with friends on one screen (hot seat, with AI bots filling seats — solo works too)
- Learn Power Grid's rules: auction rotation, the resource price track, market rebalancing and more are all in the engine
- The random seed reproduces the same game for review and discussion

## FAQ

- **Setup**: configure 2-6 seats (human or AI), then take turns picking adjacent map regions
- **Auction**: the opener starts at face value and cannot leave until outbid; others raise or drop; if everyone drops the opener wins at the opening bid
- **Resource prices**: resources occupy the most expensive block and are bought from its cheapest slot; coal/oil/garbage cost 1 at a full market of 24, uranium reaches 16 at the last piece
- **Storage**: each fuel type stores 2× its plants' demand; hybrid (coal/oil) capacity is shared between the two
- **Game end**: when any player reaches the city target (21/17/15/17/14 by player count), finish the round and score: powered cities → plant capacity → cash
- **Undo**: paid undo rolls back to your latest decision point
- **Map & data**: the map is a faithful transcription of the official Germany board (42 cities, 6 regions of 7, all 83 connection costs cross-validated against three independent open-source implementations); numeric tables are from memory of the official rules; uncertain items are flagged "to verify" in code

desc: 德式经典《波多黎各》完整规则复刻：角色选择+跟随、种植园经济、23 种建筑、货船装运。3-5 人热座同屏对局，支持 AI 机器人补位，纯前端运行。

guide.zh:
## 功能

《波多黎各》完整规则复刻（3-5 人）：每轮从总督开始轮流选角色，选角者享特权、全员跟随行动。开拓者拿地、建筑师盖楼、市长分移民、工匠生产、商人卖货、船长装船换 VP。建筑 23 种（生产/小型/大型）、货船装载与同种货锁定、交易所、仓库/码头/港口等紫建筑效果、五大建筑终局计分全部实现。

## 常见问题

- **怎么开局**：配置 3-5 个座位（可切换人类/AI），开始后按横幅提示轮流行事
- **选角顺序**：本作按「选择顺序」结算角色（⚠ 存在按固定角色行顺序的版本差异）
- **船长阶段**：能装必装（至少装 1 件）；同种货一轮只能装一条船；装完可继续装其他货物或结束

- **悔棋**：付费悔棋回退到最近一次人类待决策状态
- **规则数据**：数值表来自对官方规则的记忆整理，存疑项已在代码中标注「待核对」
guide.en:
## Features

A full-rules implementation of Puerto Rico (3-5 players): each round players take turns choosing roles; the chooser gets the privilege and everyone follows. Settler takes plantations, Builder constructs, Mayor distributes colonists, Craftsman produces, Trader sells, Captain ships for VP. All 23 buildings, cargo ships with same-good locking, the trading house, warehouses/wharf/harbor effects, and the five large buildings' endgame scoring are implemented.

## Use cases

- Play a full heavy Euro with friends on one screen (hot seat, with AI bots filling seats — solo works too)
- Learn Puerto Rico's rules: privileges, forced shipping, colonist ship supply and more are all in the engine
- The random seed reproduces the same game for review and discussion

## FAQ

- **Setup**: configure 3-5 seats (human or AI), then follow the banner prompts
- **Role order**: roles resolve in the order they were chosen (⚠ some editions use a fixed role-row order)
- **Captain phase**: you must ship at least one barrel if you can; each good type may only go on one ship per phase; after shipping you may continue or stop
- **Discard**: after the captain phase you keep only 1 barrel per good type (warehouses add capacity)
- **Game end**: VP chips running out ends the game immediately; colonist supply shortage or a full 12-slot city ends it after the current round
- **Undo**: paid undo rolls back to your latest decision point
- **Rule data**: numeric tables are from memory of the official rules; uncertain items are flagged "to verify" in code

## 功能

《璀璨宝石》规则复刻（2-4 人）：每回合三选一——拿 3 颗不同色宝石（拿 2 颗同色需该色供应 ≥4）、预留 1 张牌（明牌或牌堆顶盲留）并得 1 金（金为万能色）、或支付宝石购买明牌/预留牌。发展卡购入后永久提供产出色折扣，形成滚雪球引擎；满足在场贵族需求者回合末强制来访 +3 分（同时满足多位择一）。有人 ≥15 分后各补一回合（机会均等），VP 最高者胜，平分看购卡数少者。

- 随机种子可复现同一局，方便复盘讨论

## 常见问题

- **怎么开局**：配置 2-4 个座位（可切换人类/AI），每阶翻 4 张明牌、场上有 4 位贵族，按人数配宝石（2 人 4 颗/3 人 5 颗/4 人 7 颗，金恒 5）
- **买卡支付**：先扣本色宝石，缺口用金补；已购卡的产出色计入永久折扣（成本直接减）
- **预留**：手上至多 3 张；预留立即得 1 金（金色无法用拿宝石动作获得，只能预留获得）
- **10 颗上限**：手牌宝石（含金）超过 10 颗须弃至 10（界面点击要弃的宝石）
- **贵族**：回合末结算（先弃宝石再看贵族）；同回合至多来访 1 位
- **终局**：有人 ≥15 分当回合结束后，其余玩家各补一回合即结算
- **悔棋**：付费悔棋回退到最近一次人类待决策状态
- **数据声明**：90 张发展卡与 10 位贵族为三源交叉核对誊录（anicolao/splendor 照片验证表为主源，与 splendor-ai、NicolasVero/splendor 双源比对；二阶 2 分卡组 splendor-ai 存在 5 张转写错误，已按双源一致数据修正），卡池结构与官方完全一致（每原型 5 张旋转对称、各色成本总量 117 均等、各色产出 18 张均等）
guide.en:
## Features

A Splendor rules implementation (2-4 players): each turn pick one of three actions — take 3 gems of different colours (2 of a kind requires ≥4 in supply), reserve a card (face-up or blind from the deck) and gain 1 gold (wildcard), or pay gems to buy a face-up or reserved card. Bought cards grant permanent discounts on their produced colour, snowballing your engine; qualifying nobles visit at end of turn for +3 VP (choose one if several). Once someone reaches 15 VP everyone else gets one more turn, then highest VP wins (ties: fewest purchased cards).

## Use cases

- Play this classic card-drafting engine builder with friends on one screen (hot seat, with AI bots filling seats — solo works too)
- Learn Splendor's rules: gem economy, reservation timing and the noble race are fully implemented
- The random seed reproduces the same game for review and discussion

## FAQ

- **Setup**: configure 2-4 seats (human or AI); 4 face-up cards per tier, 4 nobles in play, gems scaled by player count (4/5/7 per colour for 2/3/4 players, 5 gold)
- **Paying for cards**: own-colour gems first, gold covers the shortfall; purchased cards count as permanent discounts on their colour
- **Reserving**: max 3 in hand; reserving immediately grants 1 gold (gold can only be obtained by reserving)
- **10-gem cap**: if your gems (incl. gold) exceed 10, discard down to 10 by clicking them
- **Nobles**: resolved at end of turn (discard first, then nobles); at most one visit per turn
- **Game end**: after the turn where someone reaches 15 VP, each other player gets one more turn, then scoring
- **Undo**: paid undo rolls back to your latest decision point
- **Data disclaimer**: the 90 development cards and 10 nobles are cross-verified transcriptions from three independent sources (anicolao/splendor's photo-verified table as primary, checked against splendor-ai and NicolasVero/splendor; splendor-ai's 5-card tier-2 transcription error corrected per the two agreeing sources); the pool structure matches the official game exactly (5 rotation-symmetric copies per archetype, 117 total cost symbols per colour, 18 cards produced per colour)

desc: 合成水果（Suika）：纯 canvas 自实现简易刚体物理（重力、圆-圆碰撞分离与反弹、堆叠），移动指针选定位置点按释放水果；同种水果接触即合并升级（🍒→🍓→🍇→🍊→🍎→🍉），两个西瓜合并得高分并消除。计分、最高分、通关纪念卡与排行榜。

guide.zh:
## 玩法

移动指针选定水平位置，点按释放下一颗水果从顶部下落。水果受重力下坠、相互碰撞堆叠；同种水果接触即自动合并为下一级并加分：🍒→🍓→🍇→🍊→🍎→🍉。两个🍉合并得高分并双双消除。分数越高越好；当堆叠越过顶部警戒线（红色虚线）即结束。

## 说明

- 物理：纯 canvas 自实现简易刚体（位置修正 + 法向冲量），无第三方物理库，水果数有限、性能开销可忽略
- 下一颗水果随机为🍒/🍓/🍇/🍊之一；🍉只能由合并产生
- 落果有短暂冷却且需落点上方无果，避免连点穿透；最高分记录在本地浏览器；通关可生成纪念卡并可上排行榜
guide.en:
## How to play

Move the pointer to pick a horizontal position and tap to drop the next fruit from the top. Fruits fall under gravity, collide, and stack; same fruits touching auto-merge into the next tier and score: 🍒→🍓→🍇→🍊→🍎→🍉. Two 🍉 merge for a big bonus and both vanish. Higher is better; the game ends when the stack crosses the red dashed danger line at the top.

## Notes

- Physics: a lightweight rigid-body solver hand-written on canvas (positional correction + normal impulse), no third-party library; fruit count is bounded so performance cost is negligible
- The next fruit is randomly 🍒/🍓/🍇/🍊; 🍉 only appears via merging
- Drops have a short cooldown and require the spawn point to be clear to prevent clip-through; best score stored locally; clearing a run generates a memorial card and may enter the leaderboard

desc: 德式经典《神秘大地》规则复刻：官方 113 格棋盘誊录、11 派系地形改造、三碗能量流转、四条邪教轨、建镇连接与六轮经济引擎。2-5 人热座同屏对局，支持 AI 机器人补位，纯前端运行。

guide.zh:
## 功能

《神秘大地》规则复刻（2-5 人）：六轮轮流行动——改造地形建民居、升级交易站/神殿/要塞/圣所、发祭司上邪教轨（锁死换终局名次分 8/4/2）、能量动作槽（每轮刷新先到先得）、燃烧碗 II 换碗 III、船运跨河（河格为通道，连续 ≤船运等级格可穿越）、造桥连接被双河隔开的对岸（29 个官方桥位，每派系限 3 座）。三碗能量流转（得能 I→II→III、支付 III→I）、对手邻建吸能、建镇（相连建筑群城镇值 ≥7 且 ≥4 座建筑即 +5VP）全部实现。

## 使用场景

- 和朋友同屏热座来一局完整德策（支持混合 AI 机器人补位，单人也能开局）
- 学习《神秘大地》规则：地形轮盘、能量经济、建镇连接等细节引擎完整实现
- 随机种子可复现同一局，方便复盘讨论

## 常见问题

- **怎么开局**：配置 2-5 个座位（可切换人类/AI），依次选派系，蛇形各放 2 座初始民居
- **派系**：11 个派系各带专长（巨人 1 铲挖 2 步、炼金以币代工、苦行僧飞毯距离 3、女巫要塞后升级送森林民居等），地形归属已按官方核对
- **能量**：三只碗 I/II/III——获得能量从 I 挪到 II（I 空则 II→III）；支付从 III 挪回 I；燃烧是独立动作（II 每 2 枚换 III 1 枚）
- **建镇**：相连建筑群（直接邻接 + 自有桥 + 美人鱼河格连接点）城镇值 ≥7（民居 1/交易站 2/神殿 2/要塞 3/圣所 3）且 ≥4 座建筑（圣所双计）即成镇 +5VP
- **过牌**：过牌时换拿一张奖励板块；下轮按本轮过牌顺序行动
- **终局**：六轮打完，四条邪教轨按名次计 8/4/2 分（并列取高），锁定祭司每枚 +1VP
- **悔棋**：付费悔棋回退到最近一次人类待决策状态
- **数据声明**：⚠ 棋盘为官方誊录（jsnell/terra-mystica @base_map 逐 token 核对，113 格 = 7 地形 × 11 + 36 河格，桥位 29 对逐对一致）；地形轮盘、建筑强度（D1/TP2/TE2/SH3/SA3）、建镇门槛（≥7 值且 ≥4 座建筑）、船运跨河、美人鱼河格连接、桥规则（每派系 3 座、每对 1 座）、派系家园地形已按官方核对。其余为记忆重建并标注「待核对」：派系缩至 11 个（官方 14），数值表（费用/收入/能量动作槽/恩惠/回合板块）存疑，已知规则偏差见引擎顶部注释（吸能自动接受、燃烧独立动作化、恩惠不可换、奖励板块随机分配、工程师造桥简化为 innate、飞毯免费）
guide.en:
## Features

A Terra Mystica rules implementation (2-5 players): six rounds of turn actions — terraform and build dwellings, upgrade to trading posts / temples / strongholds / sanctuaries, send priests onto cult tracks (locked for endgame rank VP 8/4/2), power action slots (refreshed each round, first come first served), burning bowl II into bowl III, shipping across rivers (river hexes are channels crossable up to your shipping level), and bridges over the 29 official river pairs (max 3 per faction). The three-bowl power cycle (gain I→II→III, pay III→I), leeching from neighboring builds, and town founding (connected buildings worth ≥7 town value with ≥4 buildings = +5VP) are all implemented.

## Use cases

- Play a full heavy Euro with friends on one screen (hot seat, with AI bots filling seats — solo works too)
- Learn Terra Mystica's rules: the terrain wheel, power economy, town connectivity and more are all in the engine
- The random seed reproduces the same game for review and discussion

## FAQ

- **Setup**: configure 2-5 seats (human or AI), pick factions in turn, then place 2 starting dwellings each in snake order
- **Factions**: 11 factions each with an ability (Giants dig 2 steps per spade, Alchemists pay coins per spade, Fakirs fly range 3, Witches get free forest dwellings after their stronghold, etc.); home terrains verified against the official set
- **Power**: three bowls I/II/III — gaining moves a token I→II (II→III when I is empty); paying moves III→I; burning is a standalone action (2×II → 1×III)
- **Towns**: a connected group of buildings (direct adjacency + own bridges + Mermaid river-hex connection points) with town value ≥7 (D1/TP2/TE2/SH3/SA3) and ≥4 buildings (Sanctuary counts double) founds a town for +5VP
- **Passing**: when passing you take a bonus tile; next round's turn order follows this round's pass order
- **Game end**: after six rounds, the four cult tracks pay 8/4/2 by rank (ties share the higher rank), plus 1VP per locked priest
- **Undo**: paid undo rolls back to your latest decision point
- **Data disclaimer**: ⚠ the board is an official transcription (jsnell/terra-mystica @base_map, token by token: 113 hexes = 7 terrains × 11 + 36 rivers; all 29 bridge pairs verified); the terrain wheel, building strengths (D1/TP2/TE2/SH3/SA3), town threshold (value ≥7 with ≥4 buildings), river shipping, Mermaid river connections, bridge rules (3 per faction, 1 per pair) and faction home terrains are verified against the official game. The rest is memory-reconstructed and flagged "to verify": factions reduced to 11 (official 14), numeric tables (costs/incomes/power action slots/favors/round tiles) uncertain, and known rule deviations are documented at the top of the engine (leech auto-accepted, burn as a standalone action, favor tiles not exchangeable, bonus tiles randomly assigned, Engineer bridges simplified to innate, free carpet flight)

desc: 经典俄罗斯方块：移动旋转下落方块，填满整行消除得分，每消 10 行升级提速，堆到顶部即结束，纯前端运行。

guide.zh:
## 功能

10 列 × 20 行棋盘，7 种四格方块随机下落。左右移动、旋转、软降 / 硬降，填满整行即消除并得分；每消除 10 行升一级、下落变快，方块堆到顶部则游戏结束。

## 使用场景

- 碎片时间来一局经典俄罗斯方块
- 追逐最高分与最高等级，刷新本地记录
- 通关后领取专属纪念卡收藏或分享

## 常见问题

- **操作方式**：←→ 移动、↑ 旋转、↓ 软降、空格硬降、P 暂停；移动端可滑动或使用屏上方向键
- **计分**：单消 100、双消 300、三消 500、四消 800，乘以当前等级
- **最高分保存**：最高分存储在浏览器本地，清除站点数据会重置
guide.en:
## Features

A 10×20 board with 7 tetrominoes falling at random. Move left/right, rotate, soft/hard drop; fill a full row to clear and score. Every 10 cleared rows levels up and speeds the fall; stacking to the top ends the game.

## Use cases

- Play a quick round of classic Tetris in spare moments
- Chase the highest score and level, beating your local best
- Earn an exclusive memorial card on completion to collect or share

## FAQ

- **Controls**: ←→ move, ↑ rotate, ↓ soft drop, Space hard drop, P pause; swipe or on-screen D-pad on touch devices
- **Scoring**: 1 line = 100, 2 = 300, 3 = 500, 4 = 800, times current level
- **Best score**: stored locally in the browser; clearing site data resets it

desc: 在线井字棋（Tic-Tac-Toe）小游戏，玩家对战 minimax AI，浏览器直接玩，胜负与累计胜场本地记录。

guide.zh:
## 功能

3x3 棋盘的井字棋，玩家执 X，电脑执 O 并使用 minimax 算法走最佳一步，几乎无法被击败，最多只能逼平。

## 使用场景

- 碎片时间杀时间的经典小游戏
- 体验 minimax 博弈算法的实际效果
- 给小朋友讲解棋类 AI 的入门示例

## 常见问题

- **能赢电脑吗**：minimax 永远选最优解，你最多只能平局
- **怎么重开**：点击「重新开始」按钮即可清空棋盘
- **胜场记录在哪**：保存在浏览器本地存储，清缓存会丢失
guide.en:
## Features

Classic 3x3 Tic-Tac-Toe. You play X and the computer plays O using the minimax algorithm to always pick the optimal move, making it nearly unbeatable — at best you force a draw.

## Use cases

- A quick classic game for spare moments
- See the minimax game-playing algorithm in action
- A simple demo for teaching board-game AI to kids

## FAQ

- **Can I beat the AI**: minimax always plays optimally, so the best you can do is draw
- **How to restart**: click the reset button to clear the board
- **Where are wins saved**: stored in browser local storage and lost if you clear cache

desc: Wordle 猜词游戏：6 次机会猜一个 5 字母英文单词，绿/黄/灰给出线索。内置常见词库，并支持粘贴自定义词库。计分（猜中所用次数越少分越高）、最高分、通关纪念卡与排行榜。

guide.zh:
## 玩法

6 次机会猜出 5 字母英文单词。每行输入 5 个字母后回车提交，字母会着色：**绿**=位置正确；**黄**=在词中但位置错；**灰**=不在词中。猜中所用次数越少分越高：1 次 600 分，6 次 100 分；未猜中 0 分。

## 自定义词库

展开"自定义词库"，每行粘贴一个 5 字母词（仅 A-Z），点击应用即覆盖内置词库作为答案来源。作答不强制属于词库（无大词典校验，接受任意 5 字母输入）。

## 说明

- 纯前端实现，词库与作答均在本地；最高分记录在本地浏览器
- 物理键盘或屏上键盘均可输入；通关可生成纪念卡并可上排行榜
guide.en:
## How to play

You have 6 tries to guess a 5-letter English word. Type 5 letters and press Enter; letters color: **green** = correct spot; **yellow** = in the word, wrong spot; **gray** = not in the word. Fewer tries score higher: 1 try = 600, 6 tries = 100; failing = 0.

## Custom word list

Expand "Custom word list", paste one 5-letter word (A-Z only) per line, and apply to override the built-in list as the answer source. Guesses are not required to be in the list (no large dictionary check—any 5 letters are accepted).

## Notes

- Pure front-end; the list and scoring run locally; best score is stored in your browser
- Physical or on-screen keyboard both work; clearing a run generates a memorial card and may enter the leaderboard

desc: 中国象棋小游戏，你执红方在下对弈深度 3 的 minimax AI（含蹩马腿、塞象眼、飞将、炮翻山完整规则），纯前端运行，累计胜场本地记录。

guide.zh:
## 功能

9x10 交叉点中国象棋，你执红方在下，电脑执黑方使用 negamax + alpha-beta 搜索（深度 3）走子。规则完整：蹩马腿、塞象眼、飞将禁止、炮翻山吃子全部实现。

## 使用场景

- 碎片时间与电脑对弈一局象棋
- 体验中国象棋特殊规则（蹩马腿/塞象眼/飞将/炮翻山）
- 将死或困毙电脑后领取专属纪念卡收藏或分享

## 常见问题

- **操作方式**：点击己方棋子选中，再点击高亮交叉点落子；可吃子的目标显示红环
- **AI 有多强**：深度 3 + 吃子优先排序，会主动进攻，但有 15% 概率随机选步让人有机会获胜
- **困毙算输吗**：算。中国象棋规则下，无合法步（无论是否被将）即判负
- **悔棋**：点击「悔棋」回退一回合（你的+电脑的两步）
- **累计胜场在哪**：保存在浏览器本地存储，清缓存会丢失
guide.en:
## Features

9x10 intersection Xiangqi (Chinese chess). You play Red at the bottom; the computer plays Black with a depth-3 negamax + alpha-beta search. Full rules: horse-leg blocking, elephant-eye blocking, flying-general prohibition, and cannon-over-screen captures are all implemented.

## Use cases

- Play a quick game of Chinese chess against the computer
- Experience Xiangqi's special rules (horse leg, elephant eye, flying general, cannon screen)
- Earn an exclusive memorial card after checkmating or stalemating the computer

## FAQ

- **Controls**: click your piece to select, then click a highlighted intersection to move; captures show a red ring
- **How strong is the AI**: depth 3 with capture-first move ordering; it attacks actively but has a 15% chance of picking a random top move
- **Is stalemate a loss**: yes. Under Xiangqi rules, having no legal move (checkmated or stalemated) counts as a loss
- **Undo**: click "Undo" to roll back one full turn (your move + the computer's reply)
- **Where are wins saved**: stored in browser local storage and lost if you clear cache

desc: 在线哈希计算工具，基于 Web Crypto 计算 SHA-1/256/384/512 摘要，纯前端本地运算不上传文本。

guide.zh:
## 功能

输入任意文本，调用浏览器原生 Web Crypto API 计算 SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-384、SHA-512 摘要，输出十六进制字符串并支持一键复制。

## 使用场景

- 校验文件或文本的完整性、比对内容是否一致
- 生成接口签名所需的摘要值
- 验证密码哈希、数据指纹等场景

## 常见问题

- **支持 MD5 吗**：不支持，Web Crypto 不提供 MD5，且 MD5 已不安全
- **数据会上传吗**：不会，全部在浏览器本地计算
- **大文本会卡吗**：Web Crypto 异步执行，常规文本秒级出结果
guide.en:
## Features

Compute SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 digests of any text using the browser's native Web Crypto API, output as a hex string with one-click copy.

## Use cases

- Verify text or file integrity and compare content
- Generate digest values for API signatures
- Hash passwords or data fingerprints

## FAQ

- **Is MD5 supported**: no, Web Crypto does not provide MD5 and it is insecure
- **Is data uploaded**: no, all computation runs locally in your browser
- **Will large text freeze**: Web Crypto is asynchronous, normal text finishes in milliseconds

desc: 在线 HTML 实体编解码工具，支持 & < > " ' 等特殊字符转义与反转义，纯前端处理不上传。

guide.zh:
## 功能

将文本中的 &、<、>、"、' 等特殊字符转义为 HTML 实体（如 < > &），也可把含实体的字符串反向还原为原始字符。

## 使用场景

- 在 HTML 中显示代码片段或标签时避免被解析
- 处理用户输入、防止 XSS 注入的快速转义
- 还原从接口拿到的含 HTML 实体的字符串

## 常见问题

- **支持哪些字符**：& < > " ' 五种最常见的需要转义的字符
- **解码安全吗**：使用 DOM 原生解析，仅做实体还原不执行脚本
- **数据上传吗**：纯前端处理，不发送到服务器
guide.en:
## Features

Escape special characters like & < > " ' into HTML entities (e.g. < > &) or reverse entity-laden strings back to their original characters.

## Use cases

- Display code snippets or tags in HTML without them being parsed
- Quickly escape user input to help prevent XSS injection
- Decode strings containing HTML entities returned from APIs

## FAQ

- **Which characters are supported**: the five most common ones — & < > " '
- **Is decoding safe**: it uses native DOM parsing to restore entities without executing scripts
- **Is data uploaded**: processing is fully client-side, nothing is sent to a server

desc: 在线 JSON 格式化与校验工具，支持美化、压缩、错误定位，纯前端处理不上传。

guide.zh:
## 功能

将杂乱或压缩的 JSON 字符串美化成带缩进的可读格式，同时校验语法并定位错误位置。

## 使用场景

- 调试 API 返回的 JSON，快速看清嵌套结构
- 检查 JSON 配置文件语法是否正确
- 压缩 JSON 去除空白，减小传输体积

## 常见问题

- **解析报错**：错误信息会指出行号与原因，常见是多余逗号、引号未闭合或键名缺引号
- **数据安全**：所有解析在浏览器本地完成，不上传服务器
guide.en:
## Features

Beautify compact JSON into indented readable form, validate syntax and pinpoint errors.

## Use cases

- Debug API responses and inspect nested structure
- Validate JSON config files
- Minify JSON by stripping whitespace

## FAQ

desc: 在线 JWT 解码工具，解析 token 的 header 与 payload 为可读 JSON，不验证签名，纯前端本地解析不上传。

guide.zh:
## 功能

粘贴 JWT 字符串后，按点号切分出 header 和 payload 两段，对 base64url 部分解码并以缩进 JSON 展示，方便查看其中的算法、过期时间、用户声明等字段。

## 使用场景

- 调试登录态 token，查看 sub、exp、iat 等声明是否正确
- 排查接口鉴权失败，确认 token 内容是否被篡改
- 学习 JWT 三段式结构与 base64url 编码

## 常见问题

- **会验证签名吗**：不会，本工具只解码不验签，不能据此信任 token 内容
- **数据安全吗**：解析完全在浏览器本地完成，token 不会上传服务器
- **解析报错**：token 格式不正确（少于两段或非合法 base64url）会给出错误提示
guide.en:
## Features

Paste a JWT and the tool splits it on dots, decodes the base64url header and payload segments, and displays them as indented JSON so you can inspect the algorithm, expiry, user claims and other fields.

## Use cases

- Debug login tokens by checking sub, exp, iat and other claims
- Troubleshoot auth failures by confirming token contents
- Learn the three-segment JWT structure and base64url encoding

## FAQ

- **Does it verify the signature**: no, this tool only decodes and never verifies — do not trust token contents based on it
- **Is it safe**: decoding runs fully in your browser and the token is never uploaded
- **Parse errors**: malformed tokens (fewer than two segments or invalid base64url) show an error message

desc: 涵盖自然、物理、化学、生物、地理、历史、法律与辟谣的趣味知识问答，及格发纪念卡，错题可付费看解析，纯前端本地作答不上传。

guide.zh:
## 功能

分科趣味知识问答，涵盖**自然 / 物理 / 化学 / 生物 / 地理 / 历史 / 法律**七大领域，并设**辟谣专场**（澄清常见误区）。可选单科考试或全科综合，50 题制（题库不足时自动取满），每题 2 分、满分 100、60 分及格。

- **及格**：生成可下载、可验真的纪念卡
- **满分**：可选普通纪念卡（免费）或满分特别版金卡（¥1，自觉打赏解锁）
- **非满分**：可付费查看错题解析（列出错题、你的错选、正确答案与解析，0.2 元/题）

## 使用场景

- 通识自测与科普学习，尤其辟谣题帮你纠正长期误解
- 课堂或团建的趣味答题活动
- 凑满 60 分收藏一张专属纪念卡

## 常见问题

- **题目来源**：综合维基百科、教科书与权威公开资料整理，辟谣题尽量注明依据；仅供学习参考，不替代专业意见
- **数据上传吗**：作答与计分均在浏览器本地完成，不上传服务器
- **题库会重复吗**：题库持续扩充，单科题量较少时该科考试题数自动取满；综合与辟谣专场题量充足
- **错题解析为何付费**：解析为自愿付费项，打赏支持小站即可解锁；不打赏也祝学有所获
guide.en:
## Features

A categorized fun-knowledge quiz spanning **Nature / Physics / Chemistry / Biology / Geography / History / Law**, plus a **Myth-Busting Special** that corrects common misconceptions. Pick one subject or a comprehensive mix; 50-question format (auto-fills when a subject bank is smaller), 2 pts each, 100 max, pass at 60.

- **Pass**: generate a downloadable, verifiable memorial card
- **Perfect score**: choose a free normal card OR a gold perfect-score special card (¥1, honor-system tip to unlock)
- **Non-perfect**: optionally pay for error analysis — your wrong picks, correct answers, and explanations (0.2 RMB/question)

## Use cases

- General-knowledge self-test and science popularization, especially the myth-busting set
- Fun quiz activity for classrooms or team building
- Collect a personalized memorial card by scoring 60+

## FAQ

- **Sources**: compiled from Wikipedia, textbooks and authoritative public references; myth-busting items cite evidence where possible. For learning only, not professional advice
- **Data upload**: answering and scoring run locally in your browser; nothing is uploaded

desc: 在线 Lorem ipsum 占位文本生成器，自定义段落数与每段词数，一键复制，纯前端随机生成。

guide.zh:
## 功能

按设定的段落数（1-20）和每段词数（5-200），从内置拉丁词库随机抽取拼成 Lorem ipsum 风格的占位文本，首字母大写、句末加句号，可一键复制。

## 使用场景

- 设计稿、原型图填充占位文字，专注版式而非内容
- 测试长文本在布局、分页、滚动下的表现
- 写示例接口返回数据时填充假文本

## 常见问题

- **生成的是真拉丁文吗**：不是，是拉丁词库随机组合，无实际语义
- **每次结果一样吗**：不一样，每次随机生成
- **能复制吗**：点「复制」按钮即可复制到剪贴板
guide.en:
## Features

Generate Lorem ipsum style placeholder text from a built-in Latin word pool, with configurable paragraph count (1-20) and words per paragraph (5-200). First letter capitalized, period at the end, one-click copy.

## Use cases

- Fill design mockups and prototypes with dummy text so you focus on layout
- Test how long text behaves in pagination, scrolling or responsive layouts
- Populate sample API responses with fake text

## FAQ

- **Is it real Latin**: no, it is randomly assembled from a Latin word pool with no real meaning
- **Is the result the same each time**: no, it is regenerated randomly every time
- **Can I copy it**: click the copy button to copy to the clipboard

desc: 在线 Markdown 实时预览工具，左侧编辑右侧即时渲染 HTML，纯前端解析不上传文档。

guide.zh:
## 功能

左侧输入 Markdown 文本，右侧通过内置渲染器实时输出 HTML 预览，输入即渲染，无需点击按钮。

## 使用场景

guide.en:

Type Markdown on the left and get real-time HTML preview on the right via the built-in renderer — rendering happens on every keystroke with no button to click.

## Use cases

desc: MBTI 十六型人格测试，免费版 20 题、完整版 60 题二选一得出你的四字母型态；免费看简版结果，完整版详细报告 ¥5 经站主确认后邮件送达。

guide.zh:
## 功能

通过 20 道二选一题（每个维度 5 题）快速定位你的 MBTI 四字母型态（如 INTJ、ENFP），免费查看简版结果。完整版含全部 60 题（每维度 15 题，题量更足、结果更稳），其详细报告（型态深度解析 + 优势 / 盲点 / 职场 / 关系建议）为付费项，¥5 一次，经站主确认收款后邮件送达。

## 使用场景

- 好奇自己属于哪一型，快速自测

- 为完整版深度报告做入门

## 常见问题

- **计分方式**：每个维度免费版 5 题、完整版 15 题，你选的那一极计 1 票，多者胜出决定该维度字母（完整版 15 题为奇数，无平票）

- **完整版送达**：提交邮箱+交易号后，站主确认收款即把完整报告邮件发给你
- **数据安全**：作答仅在浏览器本地计分，不上传服务器（完整版报告文本随申请提交以邮件送达）
guide.en:
## Features

Answer 20 forced-choice questions (5 per dichotomy) to find your four-letter MBTI type (e.g. INTJ, ENFP) and view a free brief result. The full edition has all 60 questions (15 per dichotomy—more items, more stable results); its detailed report (type deep-dive + strengths / blind spots / career / relationship tips) is a paid item, ¥5 one-time, emailed after the site owner confirms payment.

## Use cases

- Curious which type you are — take a quick self-test
- Team icebreakers, understanding colleagues' styles
- An entry point before buying the full deep-dive report

## FAQ

- **Scoring**: free 5 questions per dichotomy, full 15; the pole you pick earns one vote; the majority wins that letter (full edition uses 15—an odd number, so no ties)
- **Free vs full**: free gives the four-letter type + a one-line summary; the full report gives multi-paragraph analysis
- **Full delivery**: submit email + TXID; once the site owner confirms payment, the full report is emailed to you
- **Privacy**: scoring runs locally in your browser (the full-report text is submitted with the claim so it can be emailed)

desc: 在线密码生成器，自定义长度与大小写、数字、符号字符集，基于 crypto.getRandomValues 真随机，纯前端生成不上传。

guide.zh:
## 功能

按设定长度（4-128）和勾选的字符集（大写、小写、数字、符号、是否排除易混淆字符）生成随机密码，使用浏览器原生 crypto.getRandomValues 保证真随机性，可一键复制。

## 使用场景

- 注册新账号时生成高强度不可猜测的密码
- 为数据库、API Key、服务令牌生成随机串
- 演示密码强度与字符集、长度之间的关系

## 常见问题

- **安全吗**：使用 crypto.getRandomValues 真随机，比 Math.random 安全得多
- **默认排除哪些字符**：勾选「排除易混淆」后会去掉 O 0 I l 1 等形似字符
- **会上传吗**：不会，密码在浏览器本地生成后不发送任何地方
guide.en:
## Features

Generate random passwords with configurable length (4-128) and selectable character sets — uppercase, lowercase, digits, symbols, and whether to exclude ambiguous characters. Uses the browser's native crypto.getRandomValues for true randomness, with one-click copy.

## Use cases

- Generate strong, unguessable passwords when registering new accounts
- Create random strings for databases, API keys and service tokens
- Demonstrate how password strength relates to length and character set

## FAQ

- **Is it secure**: it uses crypto.getRandomValues for true randomness, far safer than Math.random
- **Which characters are excluded by default**: enabling exclude-ambiguous removes look-alike characters like O 0 I l 1
- **Is it uploaded**: no, the password is generated locally and never sent anywhere

desc: 在线像素画板，N×N 网格涂色，支持选色盘、自定义色、橡皮擦、填充桶、撤销与 PNG 导出，纯前端运行。

guide.zh:

在 N×N 像素网格上按住拖动涂色，支持选色盘取色、自定义颜色、橡皮擦、填充桶（连通同色区域一键换色）、撤销与重做，完成后导出 PNG。

## 使用场景

- 绘制复古像素风头像 / 小图标 / 表情
- 快速做像素小稿用于游戏素材或贴纸
- 给小朋友涂色玩

## 常见问题

- **涂色方式**：按住鼠标 / 手指在网格上拖动即可连续涂色
- **橡皮擦**：选中橡皮擦后涂色即清除该格（变回底色）
- **填充桶**：点击某格，与其连通的同色区域一次性换为当前色
- **撤销**：每次落笔（按下到抬起为一次笔触）记一条历史，撤销逐笔回退
- **导出**：按网格实际像素导出无网格线的 PNG
- **数据安全**：画作仅存于浏览器，不上传服务器
guide.en:
## Features

Paint on an N×N pixel grid by press-dragging; pick from a palette or a custom color, erase, flood-fill connected same-color regions, undo per stroke, and export a PNG.

## Use cases

- Draw retro pixel avatars, icons, or emojis
- Sketch quick pixel art for game assets or stickers
- A simple coloring toy for kids

## FAQ

- **Painting**: press and drag across the grid to paint continuously
- **Eraser**: select the eraser, then paint to clear cells back to the background
- **Fill bucket**: click a cell to recolor every connected cell of the same color
- **Undo**: each press-to-release stroke is one history entry; undo steps back one stroke
- **Export**: PNG is exported at native pixel resolution without grid lines
- **Privacy**: your artwork stays in the browser, nothing is uploaded

desc: 在线进制转换工具，支持二进制、八进制、十进制、十六进制互转，实时计算纯前端处理。

输入任一进制的数字，自动换算出 BIN、OCT、DEC、HEX 四种进制表示。

guide.en:

- Convert network protocol fields and memory addresses
- Verify manual conversions when learning computer science

desc: 在线正则表达式测试工具，实时匹配并高亮所有结果，支持标志位与错误提示，纯前端处理。

guide.zh:

输入正则表达式与待匹配文本，列出全部匹配项并标注序号；支持 g、i、m 等标志位。

- **标志位**：默认 g 全局匹配，去掉 g 仅返回首个匹配
guide.en:
## Features

Enter a pattern and target text to list all matches with index; supports g, i, m flags.

## Use cases

- Validate form input rules quickly
- Extract key fragments from logs or text

- **Syntax error**: the message shows the cause, e.g. unclosed parenthesis
- **Flags**: defaults to g for global; remove g to return the first match only

desc: 在线 URL Slug 生成工具，实时将标题转成小写连字符格式，去变音符号，纯前端处理不上传。

guide.zh:
## 功能

将输入文本实时转换成 URL 友好的 slug：转小写、去除变音符号与特殊字符、空格与下划线统一为连字符。

## 使用场景

- 生成博客或文档站点的 permalink
- 将商品或文章标题转成 SEO 友好的 URL 片段
- 规范化文件名、目录名

- **非拉丁字符**：会被过滤，建议先用拼音工具转换中文

guide.en:

Converts text in real time into a URL-friendly slug: lowercases, strips diacritics and special characters, joins words with hyphens.

## Use cases

- Generate permalinks for blogs or documentation sites
- Turn article or product titles into SEO-friendly URL segments
- Normalize file and directory names

## FAQ

- **Non-latin characters**: filtered out; convert Chinese to pinyin first
- **Consecutive hyphens**: collapsed into one; leading and trailing hyphens trimmed
- **Empty input**: outputs a placeholder "-" so you can tell at a glance

desc: 在线文本大小写转换工具，支持 camelCase、snake_case、kebab-case、UPPER、lower、Title 互转，纯前端处理。

guide.zh:
## 功能

一键将文本在六种命名风格之间转换：camelCase、snake_case、kebab-case、UPPER、lower、Title Case。

## 使用场景

- 编程时在变量、常量、文件名风格间切换
- 统一文档标题或按钮文案的大小写
- 清洗导入数据中的字段名

## 常见问题

- **分词规则**：按空格、下划线、连字符切分单词，连续大小写视为一个整体
- **空文本**：输出为空，需先输入内容
- **保留原文本**：UPPER 与 lower 直接转换原文本，不重新分词
guide.en:
## Features

Convert text between six naming styles with one click: camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, UPPER, lower and Title Case.

## Use cases

- Switch between variable, constant and filename conventions while coding
- Unify casing for document titles or button labels
- Clean up field names from imported data

## FAQ

- **Tokenization**: splits on spaces, underscores and hyphens; consecutive case changes are treated as one token
- **Empty input**: outputs nothing; enter text first
- **Original preserved**: UPPER and lower convert the raw text without re-tokenizing

desc: 在线文本差异对比工具，行级 diff 高亮新增与删除行，带行号与一键复制，纯前端处理不上传。

guide.zh:
## 功能

左右两栏输入文本，按行计算差异，新增行绿色、删除行红色、上下文行灰色，并显示新旧行号；结果可一键复制。

## 使用场景

- 比较两版配置文件或代码片段的改动
- 核对文档修订前后的差异
- 检查数据导出是否一致

## 常见问题

- **完全相同**：返回「内容一致」提示
- **行级对比**：按整行比较，不做字符级 diff
- **数据安全**：所有比较在浏览器本地完成，不上传服务器
guide.en:
## Features

Paste text into two panes to get a line-level diff: added lines in green, removed in red, context in grey, with old and new line numbers; results can be copied.

## Use cases

- Compare two versions of a config file or code snippet
- Review document revisions
- Verify data export consistency

## FAQ

- **Identical input**: returns an "identical" hint
- **Granularity**: compares whole lines, not characters
- **Privacy**: diffing runs locally in the browser; nothing is uploaded

desc: 在线文本行处理工具，支持排序、去重、去空白、删空行、反转，纯前端处理不上传。

guide.zh:
## 功能

对多行文本按行进行排序、去重、去首尾空白、删除空行或反转顺序，一键得到处理结果。

## 使用场景

- 清理日志或数据导出中的重复行
- 对配置项、ID 列表进行排序和去重
- 去除复制粘贴带来的多余空行

## 常见问题

- **区分大小写**：排序与去重均区分大小写，大写字母排在小写之前
- **原顺序丢失**：去重保留首次出现的行，排序后原始顺序会被覆盖
- **数据安全**：所有处理在浏览器本地完成，不上传服务器
guide.en:
## Features

Process multi-line text per line: sort, dedupe, trim whitespace, drop empty lines, or reverse order.

## Use cases

- Clean duplicate lines from logs or data exports
- Sort and dedupe config items or ID lists
- Strip extra blank lines from pasted content

## FAQ

- **Case sensitivity**: sort and dedupe are case-sensitive, uppercase comes first
- **Original order**: dedupe keeps the first occurrence; sorting overwrites the original order
- **Privacy**: all processing runs locally in your browser, nothing is uploaded

desc: 在线文本统计工具，实时计算字符数、单词数、行数、字节数与预估阅读时间，纯前端处理。

guide.zh:
## 功能

输入文本即可实时统计字符数、单词数、行数、字节数，并按 200 词/分钟估算阅读时间。

## 使用场景

- 撰写文章、推文时控制字数
- 检查字符串长度是否符合接口字段限制
- 估算博客或文档的阅读时长

## 常见问题

- **单词计数规则**：以连续非空白字符作为一个单词，中文按字符显示而非分词
- **字节数**：按 UTF-8 编码计算，中文一个字符占 3 字节
- **数据安全**：统计在浏览器本地完成，不上传服务器
guide.en:
## Features

Type to get live counts of characters, words, lines, and bytes, plus an estimated read time at 200 wpm.

## Use cases

- Keep word count within limits while writing posts or tweets
- Check string length against API field limits
- Estimate reading time for blogs or docs

## FAQ

- **Word counting**: a word is a run of non-whitespace characters; Chinese is counted by character, not segmented
- **Bytes**: UTF-8 encoded size; a Chinese character takes 3 bytes
- **Privacy**: counting runs locally in your browser, nothing is uploaded

desc: 在线 Unix 时间戳转换工具，支持时间戳转日期、日期转时间戳，秒级与毫秒级自动识别，纯前端处理。

guide.zh:
## 功能

实时显示当前 Unix 时间戳，并支持时间戳与日期字符串双向转换，自动识别秒级和毫秒级。

## 使用场景

- 调试接口中时间戳字段的实际日期
- 数据库或日志中 Unix 时间戳与可读时间互转
- 快速复制当前时间戳用于请求签名

## 常见问题

- **秒与毫秒**：输入 13 位按毫秒处理，10 位按秒处理
- **时区**：同时输出本地时间与 UTC 时间，便于跨时区对照
- **日期格式**：日期转时间戳支持 「2024-01-01 12:00:00」 或 ISO 8601 格式
guide.en:
## Features

Show the current Unix timestamp live, and convert between timestamps and date strings in both directions, auto-detecting seconds vs milliseconds.

## Use cases

- Debug the actual date behind a timestamp field in an API
- Convert Unix timestamps in databases or logs to readable time and back
- Copy the current timestamp for request signing

## FAQ

- **Seconds vs milliseconds**: 13-digit input is treated as ms, 10-digit as seconds
- **Timezone**: outputs both local and UTC time for cross-zone comparison
- **Date format**: date-to-timestamp accepts "2024-01-01 12:00:00" or ISO 8601

desc: 在线 URL 编解码工具，支持百分号编码与解码，处理特殊字符与中文，纯前端处理不上传。

guide.zh:
## 功能

对文本进行 URL 百分号编码（encodeURIComponent）或解码（decodeURIComponent），处理空格、中文及特殊符号。

## 使用场景

- 拼接带查询参数的 URL，避免中文或符号破坏结构
- 解码被编码的 URL 参数查看原始内容
- 处理接口返回的编码字符串

## 常见问题

- **解码报错**：常见于序列中存在非法百分号编码，如残缺的 「%2」
- **与 encodeURI 区别**：本工具使用 encodeURIComponent，会编码 「:」「/」「?」 等分隔符，适合查询参数
- **数据安全**：编解码在浏览器本地完成，不上传服务器
guide.en:
## Features

Encode text with URL percent-encoding (encodeURIComponent) or decode it, handling spaces, Chinese, and special symbols.

## Use cases

- Build URLs with query params without breaking them on Chinese or symbols
- Decode encoded URL params to inspect the original content
- Process encoded strings returned by APIs

## FAQ

- **Decode error**: usually caused by an illegal percent-encoding sequence such as a truncated "%2"
- **vs encodeURI**: this tool uses encodeURIComponent, which also encodes ":", "/", "?" and is suited for query params
- **Privacy**: encoding and decoding run locally in your browser, nothing is uploaded

desc: 在线 URL 解析工具，实时拆解协议、主机、路径、查询参数和锚点，纯前端处理不上传。

guide.zh:
## 功能

输入 URL 即可实时解析出协议、主机、端口、路径、查询参数、锚点及身份信息等组成部分。

## 使用场景

- 排查 URL 拼接错误，确认参数是否正确传递
- 提取并核对查询字符串中的键值对
- 分析带认证信息的 URL 结构

## 常见问题

- **解析失败**：URL 必须包含协议（http 或 https），否则浏览器无法识别
- **查询参数**：自动解码已编码的参数值，逐行展示键值对
- **数据安全**：解析在浏览器本地完成，不上传服务器
guide.en:
## Features

Type a URL to instantly break it down into protocol, host, port, path, query params, hash, and credentials.

## Use cases

- Debug URL construction and verify that params are passed correctly
- Extract and inspect key-value pairs in the query string
- Analyze URLs that carry authentication info

## FAQ

- **Parse failure**: the URL must include a protocol (http or https) or the browser cannot parse it
- **Query params**: encoded values are auto-decoded and shown line by line
- **Privacy**: parsing runs locally in your browser, nothing is uploaded

desc: 在线 UUID v4 生成工具，一键产生随机唯一标识符并复制，基于浏览器原生 crypto.randomUUID，纯前端处理。

guide.zh:
## 功能

调用浏览器原生 crypto.randomUUID 生成符合 RFC 4122 的 UUID v4 随机唯一标识符，支持一键复制。

## 使用场景

- 为新建数据记录生成唯一主键
- 前端调试时为请求生成追踪 ID
- 给文件、会话分配不重复标识

## 常见问题

- **版本说明**：仅生成 v4（随机）版本，不提供 v1 时间序或 v5 命名空间版本
- **唯一性**：v4 随机碰撞概率极低，可放心用于绝大多数业务场景
- **数据安全**：生成过程在浏览器本地完成，不上传服务器
guide.en:
## Features

Generate RFC 4122 UUID v4 random unique identifiers via the native crypto.randomUUID, with one-click copy.

## Use cases

- Generate unique primary keys for new records
- Create trace IDs for requests during front-end debugging
- Assign non-duplicate identifiers to files or sessions

## FAQ

- **Versions**: only v4 (random) is generated; v1 time-based or v5 namespace versions are not provided
- **Uniqueness**: v4 collision probability is negligible and safe for most use cases
- **Privacy**: generation runs locally in your browser, nothing is uploaded

desc: 在线视频转码工具，基于服务端 ffmpeg 将视频转换为 MP4、WebM、MKV、MOV 格式，免费 1GB，Pro 2GB。

guide.zh:
## 功能

上传视频文件，由服务端 ffmpeg 转码为目标格式（MP4 H.264、WebM、MKV、MOV），任务完成后自动下载结果。

## 使用场景

- 将手机拍摄的 MOV 视频转为 MP4 便于分享
- 把视频转成 WebM 以适配网页内嵌播放
- 统一素材格式方便后续剪辑

## 常见问题

- **上传额度**：免费用户单文件上限 1GB，Pro 用户 2GB
- **转码耗时**：取决于视频时长与服务器负载，页面会实时轮询任务状态
- **格式支持**：输出格式固定为 MP4、WebM、MKV、MOV 四种，输入可为常见视频格式
guide.en:
## Features

Upload a video and transcode it on the server with ffmpeg into MP4, WebM, MKV, or MOV; the result auto-downloads when done.

## Use cases

- Convert MOV from a phone to MP4 for easier sharing
- Transcode to WebM for web-embedded playback
- Normalize footage formats before editing

## FAQ

- **Upload quota**: free users up to 1GB per file, Pro users up to 2GB
- **Duration**: depends on video length and server load; the page polls the job status live
- **Formats**: output is limited to MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV; input can be any common video format

desc: 在线视频截断工具，按起止时间裁剪视频片段，服务端 ffmpeg 流复制无需重编码，免费 1GB，Pro 2GB。

guide.zh:
## 功能

指定起止时间，由服务端 ffmpeg 通过流复制（-ss/-to）快速裁剪视频片段，无需重新编码，完成后自动下载。

## 使用场景

- 截取视频中的精彩片段用于分享
- 去掉片头片尾冗余部分
- 从长视频中切出教学或演示片段

## 常见问题

- **上传额度**：免费用户单文件上限 1GB，Pro 用户 2GB
- **时间格式**：支持 「00:00:10」 或秒数（如 10）两种写法
- **画质无损**：采用流复制方式，裁剪过程不重新编码，画质与原片一致
guide.en:
## Features

Set start and end times to quickly cut a video clip on the server via ffmpeg stream copy (-ss/-to) without re-encoding; the result auto-downloads when done.

## Use cases

- Extract highlight clips from a video for sharing
- Trim redundant intros and outros
- Cut teaching or demo segments out of a long video

## FAQ

- **Upload quota**: free users up to 1GB per file, Pro users up to 2GB
- **Time format**: accepts "00:00:10" or seconds (e.g. 10)
- **Lossless**: uses stream copy, no re-encoding, so quality matches the source
